description: This file defines Express router endpoints related to user authentication, including registration, login, fetching current user info, and logout.

methods.name: POST /auth/register
methods.description: Handles user registration with validation, creates user and activity records, and returns auth token.

methods.name: POST /auth/login
methods.description: Authenticates user credentials, logs login activity, and returns auth token.

methods.name: GET /auth/me
methods.description: Returns current user info based on authentication token.

methods.name: POST /auth/logout
methods.description: Logs user logout activity; stateless, no token invalidation.
